Application Data.NAME: ElectroSupply Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ElectroSupply Inc. specializes in the retail and distribution of electrical equipment and supplies, including wiring, circuit breakers, and lighting fixtures. Our operations are focused on providing high-quality products to residential, commercial, and industrial clients, backed by exceptional customer service and technical support. We maintain a physical storefront at our Springfield location, which has been operational for over three years, ensuring stability and familiarity with local market conditions. Additionally, we have implemented a professionally monitored alarm system to safeguard our inventory, which is carefully managed and secured. Our revenue mix reflects a strong balance between in-store sales and online transactions, with less than 25% of total revenue derived from e-commerce activities. We also limit our installation services to under 10% of our total revenue, minimizing liability exposure related to these operations.
